target.statement: pFDTane (PerValue) run time on the BKB WaterQualityData 2020084 dataset at error threshold 0 (exact FD discovery) is 2.013 s, compared to AFDTane's 0.935 s.
target.table_ref: Table VII, row 'BKB WaterQualityData 2020084', column 'pFDTane per value' (Time)

compute.basis: The dataset is tiny (180 KB, 2370 rows) and the algorithm is a CPU TANE variant; the main cost is building Desbordante (C++/CMake) and locating the PR-300 pFDTane code, then a single run of a few seconds.

blockers: pFDTane implementation is in a pull request (PR 300) that may not be merged into the main Desbordante branch; may need to check out the PR branch or reconstruct the validation functions from Listings 3-4
Exact timing value (2.013 s) depends on hardware; reproduction would confirm order of magnitude rather than exact number
title: Extending Desbordante with Probabilistic Functional Dependency Discovery Support
